messages:
Sasha Li: Quick sync — working on joint marketplace listing with NimbusSI. Need final SSO/SCIM/KMS checklist + go-to-market timing. cc @Martin O'Neill @Elaine Cruz
Martin O'Neill: Do we have their KMS architecture diagram? They mentioned HSM-backed keys.
Elaine Cruz: They sent one yesterday, link in drive: https://drive.redwood.com/nimbus/kms-diagram v1.0. Short summary below.
Elaine Cruz: ```
- HSM vendor: FortiHSM (FIPS 140-2 L3)
- Master key material generated in HSM, keys never exported
- Supports BYOK via import and wrapping
- REST API + gRPC management endpoints
```
Todd Park: Question — for Private deployments we require customer-managed KMS. Does Nimbus support BYOK for customers? @Sasha Li
Sasha Li: Yes, they support BYOK and HSM wrapping. We still need legal/security signoff on key escrow / onboarding flow language.
security-bot: Policy scan: Nimbus HSM vendor is FortiHSM — compliance note: FIPS 140-2 L3 ok, but verify HSM module cert date. Flag: key export prohibited by vendor (good).
Martin O'Neill: On SCIM they currently do 1:many org mappings. Need to confirm group sync behavior and externalId semantics. I'll follow up with their SCIM engineer.
Elaine Cruz: Proposed announcement timeline: draft by Mon, legal review Tue, joint blog Thu. Any blockers from partners or marketing?
Todd Park: From eng: can we get a sample terraform module and a quickstart for Dedicated/Private? Also want a short matrix of supported cryptography algorithms.
Sasha Li: I'll draft the integration guide + sample terraform snippet and drop in the partnership docs repo. Example snippet:
```hcl
resource "redwood_kms_integration" "nimbus" {
  provider = "nimbus"
  wrap_mode = "hsm"
  key_policy = "customer_managed"
}
```
Martin O'Neill: :thumbsup: I'll ping their PM to lock calendar. Can someone own the compliance checklist items (SOC2/KMS attestation + vendor certs)?
Elaine Cruz: Adding checklist items now, will push a small PR to the partnerships repo with the initial compliance ask list.
Sasha Li: Thanks all — reconvene Wed 10am PT. If anything urgent, ping me in-thread or DM.
